'''Varn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At some point he became part of the [[Order of Revan]] and defected from the Republic, joining with the Revanite forces on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi's]] [[Sky Ridge Island]] under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Milenec]], whom he shared a great confidence in.

==Behind the scenes==
Varn and his fellow soldiers follow the same choice made by Milenec: betray the Revanites and return to the Republic, or defect without engaging [[Ivress]], leaving them with nowhere to go.
